Where the germinal list's Save and continue goes is the germinal flow's, set by the germinal-products area's flow rows.

Belongs with the other germinal feature-folder copies: the combiner should give it the germinal theme those rows sit in, as it touches only the germinal set's transport folder and shares the germinal flow. The shared transporter register is read, not changed, so the live and germinal lists offer the same organisation's transporters.

increments.title: Germinal products notifications have their own Upload documents page
increments.detail: Sam's 9 October ruling makes germinal products its own set in the animals frontend, each page a copy of its live-animals feature folder taken after this programme has built the live twin. Upload documents is one of the germinal set's pages: only Additional details, the CPH number and the permanent address are left out. The germinal set gets its own documents page, copied from the live-animals documents feature once the documents rows above have landed, at the same slug within the germinal journey and behaving as every adopted documents requirement says. The Live Animals Germinals Data Fields page (V4) lists no germinal-specific document fields, so the page is the live-animals page unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification, the overview's 'Upload documents' task opens a page headed 'Upload documents' with the caption 'Documents', the same guidance, the 'Check which additional documents you must upload' details, the four fields (Document reference, Document type, Date of issue, Attachment) and the same hints and buttons as the live-animals documents page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 3)

On a germinal products notification, a document with the reference 'ITAHC-001', a type, a date of issue and a PDF file is added: it is listed with 'Scanning for virus' and then 'Check completed', its 'View file' link downloads the file, and it is still listed after a reload. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:prototype-dr2-1 TRACE C actions 92-95)

On a germinal products notification, Save and add another with nothing entered shows 'There is a problem' listing 'Enter a document reference', 'Select a document type', 'Enter a date of issue' and 'Upload a document', each inline on its field. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-068)
On a germinal products notification, Remove takes a listed document off the page at once, and it is not listed after a reload. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-058)

In the germinal products opening run, Save and continue on Upload documents goes to the germinal set's Consignment addresses (roles and addresses) page; opened from the germinal overview, Back and Save and continue return to that overview. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 39)

A document added on a germinal products notification is never listed on a live-animals notification's documents page, and the live-animals set's documents page does not open a germinal products notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 4, 6)
The germinal products documents page has no serious or critical axe violations (WCAG 2.2 AA) when empty, in its error state and with a saved scanned document. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 15)
notes: Drafted here although distil/areas.json gives req-1825 to no area: it is the documents page, copied, and its criteria are this area's. The combiner should treat it as drafted and not draft it again.

Must come after every live-animals documents row that can build now (inc-031, inc-032, inc-033, inc-034, inc-035), so the copy carries their changes, and after the germinal set's own rows: the set and its mount (req-1780), its overview (req-1836), its step order and return rules (req-1898), and category scoping (req-1901, req-1885). The combiner adds those dependencies by their ids. The blocked 50MB row (inc-036) is not waited on; when it unblocks it changes both sets' pages.

The backend's accompanying-document endpoints are keyed by notification reference and need no change for a germinal notification, so backend is not in repos. Its end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit under the tests repo's animals project in the germinal-products folders (req-1806); the security spec drives the germinal documents routes through the ZAP scan. Criteria assert the page by heading and destination, never by a literal path (req-1897, req-1898).

increments.title: Germinal products roles and addresses page and party pickers
increments.detail: Gives the germinal products set its own roles and addresses page and its own five party pickers, copied from the live-animals addresses feature once this area's rows have built it, as ruling sam-2026-10-09 directs (germinal products is a sibling set of duplicated feature pages). The copy behaves as the live-animals page and pickers do, with the same words and hints, except that a germinal consignment is only ever asked for the five consignment addresses: the set has no CPH number and no permanent address section, and serves no CPH number or permanent address page. A trader importing germinal products can then record every party of the consignment within the germinal notification.
acceptanceCriteria: From a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Roles and addresses' task opens a 'Consignment addresses' page with the caption 'Consignment parties', the paragraph 'Add all the addresses that are involved in the consignment.' and the warning 'Providing a false address is an act of fraud', within that germinal products notification (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122)

For every germinal commodity the page shows exactly five sections, in this order: Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination; it shows no CPH number section and no 'Permanent address' section (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

The germinal products set offers no CPH number page and no permanent address page: nothing on its pages links to one, and opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows 'Page not found' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

Each section's hint reads as on the live-animals page, word for word, including Place of origin 'The address where the animals begin their journey to Great Britain' and Place of destination 'This is where the animals will be unloaded and accommodated for at least 48 hours. If a health certificate is required, it will show this address.' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122-m1; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-046)

Each empty row's link ('Add a place of origin', 'Add a consignor', 'Add a consignee', 'Add an importer', 'Add a place of destination') opens the germinal set's own picker for that party; choosing an address there and pressing 'Save and continue' returns to the germinal page, which shows the full address with a 'Change' link, and the address is saved on the germinal products notification only (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-001)

The germinal pickers offer the same addresses for each role, the same search, live filter, place of origin country search, 'View' link, results count and blank-save behaviour as the live-animals pickers; 'Add a new address' shows as a secondary button beside the heading on the compose stack and is left out in stub mode (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-013, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

The germinal page offers the same-as buttons ('Same as place of origin' on Consignor; 'Same as consignee' on Importer and Place of destination) under the same rules as the live-animals page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

The germinal overview's 'Roles and addresses' task shows Complete once all five parties have an address, with no CPH number or permanent address asked for (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

In Welsh the germinal page and pickers show the same Welsh text as the live-animals ones, and they have no serious or critical accessibility violations (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-002, repo-frontend-p9-089)

The germinal products set has no CPH number page and no permanent address page: nothing in the set links to, asks for or serves a CPH number or an animal's permanent address (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-064, confluence-6497338582-p1-065; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p9-002, prototype-dr2-1-source-p9-024; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

On the germinal products overview, section 'Consignment parties' holds the single row 'Roles and addresses' with the hint 'Consignor or Exporter, Consignee, Importer and Place of Destination', and the row reads 'Complete' once the consignment addresses are complete (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-034, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-035; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-152; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)
notes: New on this re-distil, from Sam's 9 October ruling and the germinals data fields source. Combines req-1826 (the germinal half of req-574: five sections only, no CPH number or permanent address) and req-1827 (the germinal set's own copy of the page and pickers), because they are one page and one copy: building the copy without its section rule would show a CPH row the set cannot answer. Ruling sam-2026-10-09 (p1-014) says each germinal page is copied after this programme has built its live twin, so this row depends on every live-animals row of this area. It also depends on the germinal products set's own mount, journey, flow and overview (req-1898, ruling p1-006) in another area, which this draft cannot name by id: the combiner adds that dependency. Ruling p1-058 puts the germinal set in one theme, germinal-products, in the last wave: this row belongs there, not in consignment-parties. Where 'Add a new address' leads from a germinal picker, and the INS address book's return to the germinal set, are req-1831's (INS themes, proven in the ins Playwright project); this row observes only the button. The 'Roles and addresses' overview row with its hint is req-1840 (overview area); the completion criterion here is the page's own rule (req-584 in the copy) observed through that row. The full germinal walk-through spec is req-1899's. The routes and form fields stay the real service's, with the live-animals slugs (req-1828 exists, req-1829 out of scope). Same behaviour in stub mode and on the compose stack, as for the live-animals pickers.

The combiner adds req-1832, req-1833 and req-1840, which no area drafted: the missing CPH and permanent address pages and the overview's Roles and addresses row are this page's rules, observable once the germinal overview (inc-099) and this page exist. The INS address book's germinal entry (req-1831) is inc-180, in an INS theme, as ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 14 puts INS-side germinal work.

increments.title: The germinal set has no Additional details step, and a germinal species counts as identified once it has one identifier
increments.detail: The germinal set leaves out the Additional details page: its overview has no Additional details task, and a valid identification page reached through the journey goes straight to Arrival details. Every germinal identification field is optional on its own, but V4 needs at least one germinal identifier: a germinal species counts as identified, for the overview's Complete status and for submit, once its entry holds at least one of the four.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal notification's overview has no Additional details task: its section 2 holds 'Commodity details', and 'Identification details' where it applies, only. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-150; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016)

'Save and continue' on a valid germinal identification page reached through the journey goes straight to Arrival details; opened from its overview task, the review or the template review, it returns there instead. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-056; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-085; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

Saving a germinal species' form partly or wholly blank shows no missing-value error and never stops 'Save and continue'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-026; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-060; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-028, -p1-033, -p1-038, -p1-043)

The overview's Identification details task shows Complete only once every selected germinal species, a lone species included, has at least one of the four identifiers saved; the identification page shows no message for this rule. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-071, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-072; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, -p1-189; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-086)

Submitting a germinal notification with a species whose entry holds no identifier is refused, and it submits once that species has one identifier. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, -p1-189; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-085)
notes: Combines the missing Additional details step (req-181) with the one-identifier bar (req-261): both are the germinal set's flow and obligation rules around identification, and both can only be observed once the germinal hub, review, template review, Arrival details and declaration copies exist. Kept apart from the identification page rows so those build early.

Depends on the combiner's germinal copies of the hub (req-1836), the review (req-1843), template mode (req-1876), Arrival details (req-1898) and declaration and submit, and on the draft row 'Germinal identification asks once per species for donor, dates and identification number, and the backend stores them' in this area. inc-099 and inc-105 hold the germinal hub and review differences today.
Ruling claims 188 and 189: one identifier is enough, with one bar for Complete and for submit.

increments.title: The INS address book takes adds from germinal products notifications and returns to them
increments.detail: A trader adding an address from a germinal products notification's party picker crosses to the INS address book by the same handshake and the same add page as from live animals, with the same address record and rules. The INS address book accepts the germinal products set as well as live animals and, on save or cancel, returns to the germinal set's own address-return page for that notification, built on the server from a registered entry in the INS service's conventions. Ruling claim 11 lets this land before the germinal set itself.
acceptanceCriteria: The INS address book's add page accepts a handshake from the germinal products set, as it accepts one from live animals, and shows the same add page (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-095, repo-insfrontend-p3-097; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Saving or cancelling an add begun from a germinal products notification sends the trader to the germinal set's address-return page for that notification, under /germinal-products/notifications/{notification id}, and never to a live-animals notification (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-102, repo-insfrontend-p3-112; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-134, repo-frontend-p9-139)
The return address is built on the server from the registered germinal products entry, and a handshake that names any other return address is refused (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-112)

An address saved from a germinal products notification is the same address record, with the same fields and checks, as one saved from a live-animals notification (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-069)
notes: Drafted by the combiner: no area drafted req-1831. ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 14 keeps INS-side germinal work in the INS themes, proven in the ins Playwright project, so this row sits with the journey registry in consignment-parties and the germinal addresses page (inc-181) depends on it. Its return destination is observed as the redirect the INS frontend sends; claim 11 lets it land on main before the germinal page it points at.

increments.title: The rest of the germinal journey: arrival details, transit countries, contact address, declaration and submission, in Design Release 2.1's step order
increments.detail: The germinal products set follows the same Design Release 2.1 step order, return rules, shared journey buttons and status strip as the live-animals set, from copies of the live-animals pages once this programme has changed them, except that the additional details, CPH number and permanent address steps never apply. This row copies the pages the earlier germinal rows do not (arrival details, transit countries, the contact address page, the declaration and the submitted page) and wires the set's run end to end, so a germinal notification can be submitted. The certified-for answer is set to 'Germinal products' when the draft is created, so nothing asks it, and it reads back on the review with no Change link.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal products set has its own Arrival details, Transit countries and contact address pages, each with the same content, controls, validation and page endings as the live-animals page this programme builds (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-007, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

Walked through the journey, a germinal products notification visits its pages in the live-animals run's order with the Additional details, CPH number and permanent address steps left out, and reaches the review after the contact address page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-010, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-013)

A germinal page opened from its overview task returns to the overview on Save and continue, and one opened from the review returns to the review, as in the live-animals set (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

The germinal products set has its own declaration page and Notification submitted page, copied from the live-animals ones: declaring a complete germinal notification submits it and shows the submitted page with its GBN-AG reference, and the notification then opens in the germinal set's view with the same header as a live-animals one (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

A newly created germinal-products notification's review shows an Additional details block with one row, 'Certified for', reading 'Germinal products', before any journey page has been answered (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-091, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-092; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-079)

The 'Certified for' row of a germinal-products notification's review has no Change link (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-020; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-094; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-079)

Submitting a germinal-products notification publishes the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS declaration clause carrying 'Germinal products', seen in that notification's published event in the admin's outbox view (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-055)

A newly created live-animals notification is not certified for anything until the trader answers the certification question: its review shows no 'Germinal products' answer (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

When transit countries are required for the germinal products notification, section 3 shows 'Transit countries' between 'Arrival details' and 'Transport details', reading 'To do' until at least one transit country is selected, then 'Complete' (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:6552-6556; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12 germinal hub)
notes: Drafted by the combiner: no area drafted req-1898, the germinal set's step order and the pages no other germinal row copies. It also takes req-1839 (the germinal Transit countries task, moved from inc-099, because the task needs this row's transit countries page) and req-182 (the germinal certified-for answer, from the reason-and-additional-details area's draft, because its review and published criteria need the germinal review and submit). The backend already stores certified-for as free text and publishes it as the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS clause (req-1590, already met), so no backend change is expected. The end-to-end walk is inc-184.

increments.title: End-to-end proof: a germinal products notification for bovine semen, from create to submitted
increments.detail: The tests repo proves the germinal set end to end with one walk in its existing animals Playwright project, as it does for the live-animals journeys, so the germinal set's pages are shown to join up from create to submit.
acceptanceCriteria: A spec in the tests repo's existing animals Playwright project walks a germinal products notification for bovine semen from create to submitted: Netherlands as the country of origin, a total gross weight and a number of packages, Frozen, Internal market for Breeding, donor identification entered once for the species, Port of Dover by Road with transit through Belgium, and a consignee chosen in roles and addresses (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-072, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-204; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-063; repo:tests repo-tests-p1-166)

Before declaring, the walk checks that the germinal review shows each answer it gave (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-203, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-148; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)
notes: Drafted by the combiner: no area drafted req-1899. It follows the live-animals end-to-end proof rows (inc-005, inc-019, inc-058): the behaviour is built by the germinal rows it depends on, and this row adds the walk across them.

increments.title: Amend, cancel amend, copy as new and delete for germinal products notifications
increments.detail: A submitted germinal products notification is managed on the germinal set's own copies of the amend, cancel amend, copy as new, notification actions and delete pages, taken from the live-animals ones once this programme has changed them. The delete page counts packages where live animals count animals, and a copy stays a germinal products notification with its certified-for answer.
acceptanceCriteria: A submitted germinal products notification offers Amend, Cancel amend, Copy as new and Delete through the germinal set's own pages, with the same dialogs, wording and destinations as a live-animals notification (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

On the germinal products delete page, the Number row shows the notification's total number of packages (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-175; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

Copying a germinal products notification makes a germinal products draft with a new GBN-AG reference that opens in the germinal set and not the live-animals set; copying a live-animals notification still makes a live-animals draft (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-031; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-034)

A copy of a germinal products notification keeps the certified-for answer 'Germinal products' and never shows 'Further keeping' in its place (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-070)
notes: Drafted by the combiner: no area drafted req-1878, req-1879 or req-1880. Option B plan's inc-178 and inc-182 (amend, copy and actions; delete with packages) are combined: they are copies of the manage-notifications feature folders in one set, observed on one submitted germinal notification. The backend's copy keeps the source's category (req-1885 is inc-176's).

increments.title: Germinal products templates are answered on the germinal set's pages, and using one starts a germinal notification
increments.detail: A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own question pages in template mode, so it never asks additional details, a CPH number or a permanent address. It is saved, listed with its category, viewed, changed and deleted like any template, and using it starts a germinal products notification seeded with the answers that fit the germinal set. The germinal origin page's Back link follows where the page was opened from, the template review included.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's question pages in template mode: its task list has no Additional details task and it asks no CPH number or permanent address (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-127, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

A saved germinal products template is listed on Manage templates with the category 'Germinal products', and is viewed, changed and deleted like any template (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-051; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-066)
'Use template' on a germinal products template starts a germinal products notification in the germinal set (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-051, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Using a germinal products template seeds the main reason for import, the purpose in the internal market only when the reason is 'Internal market', and the storage temperature only when it is one of the germinal products temperature options (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-067, prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021)

A notification started from a germinal products template is certified for 'Germinal products', and nothing about unweaned animals is asked or seeded (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

In the germinal set, the origin page's Back link goes to the notification type question when the notification was started from it, to the germinal products notifications list when started from that list, to the overview when the page was opened from the overview, and to the template review when a germinal products template is being edited (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-005; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)
notes: Drafted by the combiner: no area drafted req-1875, req-1876 or req-1740. Option B plan's inc-179, inc-180 and inc-181 are combined: germinal template mode, using a germinal template, and the origin Back link whose template-review clause needs germinal template mode. Templates carry their type (inc-161), so a germinal template's card links to the germinal set.

increments.title: A draft's review shows the view header with its Draft status and stays editable
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 heads a draft's review the way it heads a submitted notification's view, and keeps it editable with what is still incomplete listed. The 9 October ruling keeps that content, keys the header on the real service's one review route and the stored status, and keeps dashboard draft rows going to the hub (c-246). Today a draft's review, reached from the hub's 'Review and submit', has the journey heading and the status strip and no header. Afterwards the same review, for a Draft, shows the view header with the Draft tag, the reference as heading, the date created, Copy as new, Delete and the Import reference numbers, and stays editable: every card has its Change link, incomplete sections are listed in an error summary and under each card's heading, and the page ends with Continue.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft's review, reached from the hub's 'Review and submit', shows the notification reference as the h1 with a 'Draft' tag beside it, in place of the 'Review your notification' heading and the status strip (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-008, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-009; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-089, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-104; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-096, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-097; c-246)

Under the header the draft's review shows 'Date created: <d Month yyyy>', the date the notification was created (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-012; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-104)

The draft's review header offers 'Copy as new' and a red 'Delete' warning button that opens the notification's delete confirmation, and no 'Amend this notification' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-009; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-104; c-246)

The draft's review shows the 'Import reference numbers' section with its warning, the 'Notification reference' and 'Customs document code' rows and their Copy buttons, as a submitted notification's view does (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-104; c-246)
Every card on the draft's review has a Change link to its question page (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-105; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-110)

When the draft has incomplete sections, the review shows a 'There is a problem' error summary listing each one, each entry linking to its card, and an error message under each incomplete card's heading (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-105, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-106)
The draft's review ends with a Continue button (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-106; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p13-001)

On the workspace stack and in CDP the draft's review has a Back link to the overall dashboard in the INS front door; in the animals frontend's own fit run, with no INS front-door URL configured, it goes to /live-animals (c-143; c-246)
On the dashboard, a draft's row still opens its overview hub, not the review (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-097; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-111; c-246)
notes: Drafted by the combiner for req-900, which c-246 settles: the 9 October ruling (claims 96 and 97) keeps req-900's content, keys the header on the real review route (notification-view) and the stored Draft status, and keeps dashboard draft rows going to the hub; the prototype's separate header-less journey review is a route split the prototype does not decide, so it is not built. Kept apart from the submitted-view header row (inc-111) because it reuses that row's header and the header-actions row's Copy as new, Delete and Import reference numbers (inc-112), so it follows both. The incomplete-card messages are the review cards row's (inc-101) and Continue is the review-ending row's (inc-110); this row shows they hold under the draft's header. The Back link uses the INS front-door URL from inc-111, with its /live-animals fallback (c-143).
